paragraphs:
Sabrina Suppa is an artist and designer specialising in digital modelling. 
Her practice explores the body as a site of forced evolution, creating forms that appear organic yet are shaped by technical precision. Drawing from nature, she alters biological references to an extreme, using technology to imagine hybrid body architectures suspended between the natural and the artificial.

In 2025, she began extending her digital practice into 3D printing and physical fabrication, developing architectures that reshape the human silhouette through a post-human lens. 
Her work imagines the body as an adaptive structure - capable of evolving, protecting, and transforming itself in response to shifting realities. Influenced by her studies in classical piano and interior design, she translates rhythm, structure, and geometric abstraction into sculptural forms.

She has been working as a character artist and facial modeller in studios within the film and game industries such as Framestore, DNEG, MPC and Ninja Theory where she cultivates her fascination with anatomical studies and the expressive potential of the human body.
